270.value: Linear camera-native RGB (sensor primaries), NO colour matrix, no transfer curve. THIS IS NOT sRGB -- do not treat it as such. This is the measurement output. White balance: as-shot per-channel gains, green = 1, applied AFTER black subtraction and normalisation by (white - black), and AFTER the noise model, which is calibrated in raw DN before any gain.
